name: Phantom Soldiers
disable: DC 45 Intimidation check (legendary) to scare off the soldiers or DC 46 Deception check (legendary) to order the soldiers to stand down

items.name: Battle
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area

---

Effect Spirit soldiers lunge out of the mist and attack intruders. The spirit soldiers attempt a spear Strike against each creature within 30 feet.

text: Spirits of long-dead soldiers appear in the mist and attack intruders.
